name: Jezero Crater - Western Delta (PRIMARY)
science_goal: Study delta deposits and sampled rocks along a planned Marswalk

layers.name: Elevation / Slope
layers.product: MGS MOLA global DEM mosaic crop
layers.limitation: Coarse global fallback; local landforms and hazards smaller than the source pixel are unresolved.

warnings: 4.7% of the region has NO elevation data (shown grey, routes never cross it).
Elevation source resolution is 463 m: route feasibility is coarse and does not resolve small landforms.
No imagery file for this region: imagery layer is MISSING (not faked).
Elevation grid is 463 m/pixel: slope is a coarse indicator; boulders and small hazards are NOT resolved.

crs.grid: local equirectangular metre grid, row 0 = north edge; every layer shares this exact grid
crs.alignment: All raster layers are produced on one grid (same width/height/cell), so they overlay pixel-for-pixel.
